class.name: EllipsoidShape3D
class.brief_description: A 3D ellipsoid shape used for physics collision.
class.description: A 3D ellipsoid shape, intended for use in physics. Usually used to provide a shape for a [CollisionShape3D]. The shape's surface is defined by the equation [code]x² / radius_x² + y² / radius_y² + z² / radius_z² = 1[/code], where the radii are the semi-axes of the ellipsoid along the X, Y and Z axes. When all radii are equal, this shape is identical to a [SphereShape3D] with the same radius. [b]Performance:[/b] [EllipsoidShape3D] is fast to check collisions against, though slower than [SphereShape3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This shape is only supported by the Jolt Physics engine.

members.member: The ellipsoid's radii, which act as the semi-axes of the shape along the X, Y and Z axes. Each component must be greater than 0.
